mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates in equity valuation models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.0% over 3 months signals monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint RSAFS and HOUST growth fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising employment growth (PAYEMS) signals sustained corporate hiring that supports profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 for PAYEMS signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (RSAFS) indicates sustained household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through immediate earnings impact.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1000.0 thousand units) signals reduced consumer durable spending, lowering corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS) and inflation above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) indicates policy response to inflation, temporarily boosting equity valuations through growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals economic deceleration, reducing earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
